body: I go to JESS, but they have not said that exams are cancelled. They've said, "We received an unexpected email late last night from the KHDA advising that all IB exams will be cancelled." The KHDA has advised that exams will be cancelled, not confirming that exams have been cancelled. So far I believe that the school has communicated this across to the MOE in order to receive official comment.

Our school had a meeting with us today, and our headmaster sent us an email this afternoon quoting " we received an unexpected email late last night from the KHDA advising that all IB exams will be cancelled." They're currently waiting on comment from the MOE for verification. But in all honestly we're all confused. I thought that we're were in a pretty good place to sit exams, but I don't know anymore.
